race.comment: WITCH OF NOVEMBER (4) is the top pick despite the Griffith seventh, as she was back over 1350m in a Class 1 and now returns to a more suitable 1000m with a 2kg claim. Her one win and four placings from eleven starts at the distance give her the strongest set-up. SOHO SUSHI (3) has the steadier recent platform, second at this track last start and narrowly beaten the run prior, though she has placed rather than won in four track-and-distance attempts. Due for a change of luck. BEAU ROCK (7) brings the best track-and-trip record, three wins and four placings from 14, and the return from 1200m/1400m keeps him in the mix if his recent plain run lifts. PROPHET TIME (5) deep into the prep and look for improvement in the small field from the low gate.
